title: House & Siding Washing
shortDescription: Restore your home's curb appeal with professional soft washing for vinyl, brick, stucco, and aluminum siding. Removes years of dirt, mould, and algae safely.
fullDescription: Your home's exterior takes a beating from Southwestern Ontario's weather — rain, snow, humidity, and UV exposure create layers of dirt, mould, mildew, and algae that dull your siding and can cause permanent damage if left untreated. At Spotless Property Cleaning, we use a low-pressure soft wash technique combined with eco-friendly, biodegradable detergents to safely clean vinyl, brick, stucco, aluminum, and wood siding without risking damage from high-pressure spray. Our process kills mould and algae at the root, so your home stays cleaner longer. A professional house wash not only transforms your home's appearance instantly — it also protects your investment by preventing premature paint failure, wood rot, and siding degradation. Whether you're prepping for a sale, hosting guests, or simply want your home looking its best, our house washing service delivers dramatic results every time.
features: Safe low-pressure soft wash technique
Eco-friendly biodegradable detergents
Kills mould and algae at the root
Safe for all siding types
Prevents premature paint failure and rot

title: Driveway & Walkway Cleaning
shortDescription: Blast away oil stains, tyre marks, mould, and ground-in grime from concrete, interlock, and asphalt driveways and walkways.
fullDescription: Driveways and walkways are the hardest-working surfaces on your property — they absorb oil drips, tyre marks, de-icing salt residue, mould, and years of ground-in dirt that regular hosing can't touch. Our commercial-grade hot water pressure washing system cuts through the toughest stains on concrete, interlocking brick, natural stone, and asphalt without damaging the surface. We use surface cleaners (not just wands) for an even, streak-free finish across the entire area. For interlock, we can also remove weeds growing between joints and apply polymeric sand to restore the clean, locked look. Oil-stained garage aprons, black algae on shaded walkways, salt-bleached front paths — we've seen it all and we know exactly how to make each surface look like new again. A clean driveway and walkway dramatically improves your property's curb appeal and eliminates slippery mould that creates a safety hazard.
features: Hot water removes oil and grease stains
Surface cleaners for even, streak-free results
Safe for concrete, interlock, stone, and asphalt
Removes mould, algae, and salt residue
Optional polymeric sand for interlock joints

title: Deck & Fence Restoration
shortDescription: Bring weathered wood, composite, and vinyl decks and fences back to life. Removes grey oxidation, mildew, and stains for a like-new finish.
fullDescription: Ontario's freeze-thaw cycles, summer humidity, and UV exposure take a heavy toll on decks and fences — wood turns grey, composite grows mildew, and vinyl yellows or greens with algae. Our deck and fence restoration service uses carefully calibrated pressure and specialized wood-brightening agents to strip away grey oxidation, mildew stains, and embedded dirt without splintering wood fibres or damaging composite surfaces. For wood decks and fences, we can also apply a protective stain or sealant after cleaning to extend the life of the surface and keep it looking great for years. We handle all deck and fence materials: pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, composite (Trex, TimberTech), and vinyl. The result is a surface that looks freshly installed — perfect for backyard entertaining, increasing property value, or simply enjoying your outdoor space without embarrassment.
features: Calibrated pressure for each material type
Wood-brightening agents restore natural colour
Handles wood, composite, and vinyl
Optional stain or sealant application
Extends deck and fence lifespan

title: Roof & Gutter Cleaning
shortDescription: Soft wash roof cleaning removes black streaks, moss, and lichen without damaging shingles. Plus gutter brightening and debris removal.
fullDescription: Those dark streaks running down your roof aren't just unsightly — they're a living organism called Gloeocapsa magma, an algae that feeds on the limestone filler in asphalt shingles. Left untreated, it shortens your roof's lifespan by years and can void your shingle warranty. Our soft wash roof cleaning system applies a low-pressure treatment that kills the algae, moss, and lichen at the source without the damaging force of high-pressure washing that can lift shingles and strip granules. We also provide gutter cleaning (removing leaves, debris, and clogs) and gutter brightening — removing the black tiger-stripe staining that forms on the outside of aluminum gutters. Clean gutters protect your foundation from water damage while a clean roof restores your home's appearance and protects your roofing investment. We follow manufacturer recommendations to ensure your warranty stays intact.
features: Low-pressure soft wash protects shingles
Kills algae, moss, and lichen at the root
Gutter debris removal and downspout clearing
Gutter exterior brightening
Follows manufacturer warranty guidelines

title: Building & Storefront Washing
shortDescription: Keep your commercial property looking professional. We clean retail storefronts, office buildings, warehouses, and industrial exteriors.
fullDescription: First impressions matter in business, and a dirty exterior sends the wrong message to customers, tenants, and visitors. Spotless Property Cleaning provides comprehensive commercial exterior cleaning for retail storefronts, office buildings, strip malls, warehouses, restaurants, and industrial facilities throughout Southwestern Ontario. We use both high-pressure and soft wash techniques depending on the surface — concrete block, brick, EIFS/stucco, metal cladding, glass curtainwall, and vinyl siding all require different approaches, and we know which to use. Our team works around your business hours to minimize disruption, and we carry full commercial liability insurance and WSIB coverage. Regular commercial exterior cleaning doesn't just improve appearance — it demonstrates professionalism, maintains property value, and prevents costly damage from biological growth that can penetrate building envelopes. We offer one-time deep cleans and ongoing maintenance contracts for property managers.

Work scheduled around business hours

title: Parking Lot & Garage Cleaning
shortDescription: Heavy-duty cleaning for parking lots, parkades, and garage floors. Removes oil stains, gum, tyre marks, and winter salt buildup.
fullDescription: Parking lots and garages accumulate oil, grease, antifreeze, chewing gum, tyre marks, and months of de-icing salt that regular sweeping can't remove. These contaminants don't just look bad — oil-soaked concrete becomes a slip hazard, salt residue accelerates surface deterioration, and a neglected parking area deters customers and tenants. Our commercial hot water pressure washing system combined with industrial degreasers cuts through the toughest parking lot stains, restoring concrete and asphalt surfaces to a clean, professional appearance. We use surface cleaners for uniform results across large areas and can handle everything from a small retail lot to multi-level parkades. For property managers, we offer seasonal deep cleaning packages — especially valuable after winter when salt and sand buildup is at its worst. We also provide line-painting prep cleaning to ensure fresh paint adheres properly and lasts.

Removes oil, gum, tyre marks, and salt

title: Fleet & Equipment Washing
shortDescription: On-site washing for trucks, trailers, heavy equipment, and commercial vehicles. Maintain a professional fleet image and prevent corrosion.
fullDescription: A clean fleet is a professional fleet. Dirt, road salt, grease, and grime don't just make your vehicles look bad — they accelerate rust, corrode undercarriages, and can even cause mechanical problems by clogging radiators and air filters. Spotless Property Cleaning provides on-site fleet and equipment washing for contractors, trucking companies, landscapers, and any business that relies on vehicles and heavy machinery. We bring our commercial hot water pressure washing rigs to your yard or depot, so your vehicles don't have to go anywhere. We handle box trucks, flatbeds, dump trucks, excavators, skid steers, trailers, service vans, and more. Our process removes road film, mud, hydraulic fluid, concrete splatter, and winter salt without damaging paint, decals, or electrical components. Regular fleet washing extends vehicle life, prevents warranty-voiding corrosion, and ensures your brand looks its best on every job site and road.

title: Graffiti Removal
shortDescription: Fast, effective graffiti removal from brick, concrete, metal, stone, and painted surfaces. We also apply anti-graffiti coatings to prevent repeat vandalism.
fullDescription: Graffiti vandalism is more than an eyesore — it signals neglect, can attract more vandalism, and may violate municipal bylaws if not removed promptly. Spotless Property Cleaning provides fast-response graffiti removal for commercial and residential properties throughout London and Southwestern Ontario. We use a combination of hot water pressure washing, specialized chemical strippers, and surface-appropriate techniques to remove spray paint, marker, sticker residue, and etching from brick, concrete, stone, stucco, metal, wood, and painted surfaces. Different surfaces require different approaches — aggressive chemicals that work on bare concrete would damage painted stucco, so we match our method to your surface every time. After removal, we can apply a sacrificial or permanent anti-graffiti coating that makes future vandalism wipe off with minimal effort — saving you time, money, and frustration if the same spot gets hit again. For property managers and municipalities, we offer rapid-response agreements for removal within 24-48 hours of notification.
features: Removes spray paint, marker, and stickers
Surface-matched techniques prevent damage
Anti-graffiti protective coatings available
